featured.title: SemorIQ
featured.subtitle: Plan smarter. Study better.
featured.description: A full-stack academic planning SaaS built with Next.js, Supabase, and Tailwind. Features semester management, course tracking, Kanban task boards, collaborative notebooks with a canvas editor, real-time presence, Google OAuth, i18n support (English, Hebrew, Spanish), and a freemium billing system. Deployed on Vercel with Cloudflare DNS.
featured.image: /images/projects/Sign Up or Log In with Google on SemorIQ.gif

featured.title: Personal Portfolio
featured.subtitle: Design. Code. Showcase.
featured.description: A modern, responsive portfolio built to showcase my projects, skills, and experience. Features smooth animations, a dynamic project carousel, and a clean UI focused on clarity, performance, and developer-friendly structure.

featured.title: Out of Phase
featured.subtitle: Dimension-switching cyberpunk detective game
featured.description: A first-person Unity investigation game where you shift between five overlapping dimensions to solve puzzles and track an interdimensional killer. Focused on immersive exploration, layered environments, and a distinct cyberpunk atmosphere.

featured.title: REACTFLIX
featured.subtitle: Offline Media Streaming Platform
featured.description: REACTFLIX is a self-hosted media streaming platform built with a Flask backend and a React frontend. It supports movies and TV series, season-based posters, subtitles (Hebrew & English), pagination, genre filtering, and admin-only uploads. Designed to run fully offline on a local or internal network.

featured.title: Blade Spinners
featured.subtitle: Spin. Clash. Conquer.
featured.description: A Beyblade-inspired roguelike built in Unity 6 (URP). Features momentum-based physics combat where collisions exchange spin energy, procedural part generation with 5 customizable components, state-machine AI opponents, and a GTA/Xenoverse-style camera system. Pure C# gameplay with no visual scripting.
